title: peltandra virginica
intro: Peltandra virginica, commonly known as American arrow arum, is a plant species within the family Arum. American arrow arum is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include being an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of Peltandra virginica include reducing inflammation, treating skin conditions, and providing relief from pain and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
